en: Receptionist
Welcome to the Battle Dome! Sixteen Trainers meet in a tournament, and four wins in a row make a champion.
You've won {number} tournaments in a row. The field gets tougher with every one!
Would you like to enter a tournament?
Enter
The rules
No
You need three Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Please choose the three Pokémon you'll enter.
Thank you! The bracket has been drawn. This way to the hall, please!
I'm sorry. The three entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the three entered may hold the same item.
Please come again. There's always another tournament about to begin.
Your three battle at Level 50, or at their own level if it's lower. Nothing you do here changes them.
Before every match you'll see your opponent's three, and you send two of yours into a battle of one on one.
Win the final and you're the champion. Lose a match, and the tournament is over for you.
Receptionist
Welcome to the Battle Palace! Here your Pokémon battle as their natures tell them to.
You've won {number} battles in a row here. Your Pokémon must trust you!
Would you like to take on the Battle Palace?
Enter
The rules
No
You need three Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Please choose the three Pokémon you'll enter.
Thank you! Seven Trainers are waiting. This way to the hall, please!
I'm sorry. The three entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the three entered may hold the same item.
Please come again. Your Pokémon will be glad of the chance to speak for themselves.
Your three battle at Level 50, or at their own level if it's lower. They are made whole after every battle.
You give no orders here. Each Pokémon chooses its moves by its nature, bolder or warier as its HP runs low.
Beat seven Trainers in a row to win the round. Lose once, and the round is over.
Receptionist
Welcome to the Battle Arena! Every bout is fought to a finish, or to the judge's verdict.
You've won {number} battles in a row here. The judges know your name!
Would you like to take on the Battle Arena?
Enter
The rules
No
You need three Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Please choose the three Pokémon you'll enter, in the order they'll fight.
Thank you! Seven Trainers are waiting. This way to the arena, please!
I'm sorry. The three entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the three entered may hold the same item.
Please come again. The judges are always watching.
Your three battle at Level 50, or at their own level if it's lower, one at a time in the order you chose.
No switching! A bout still going after three turns is judged on Mind, Skill and Body, and the loser is out.
Beat seven Trainers in a row to win the round. Lose once, and the round is over.
Receptionist
Welcome to the Battle Pike! Three doors, fourteen rooms, and luck as your fourth Pokémon.
You've passed {number} rooms in a row here. The Pike remembers you!
Would you like to take on the Battle Pike?
Enter
The rules
No
You need three Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Please choose the three Pokémon you'll enter.
Thank you! The first three doors are waiting. Good luck, and choose well!
I'm sorry. The three entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the three entered may hold the same item.
Please come again. The doors will still be here, and still be hiding things.
Your three go in at Level 50, or at their own level if it's lower. Nothing heals them unless a room does.
Before every room you choose one of three doors. Behind it there may be a battle, a rest, a wild Pokémon, or worse.
Pass fourteen rooms to win the round. If all three of yours faint, the round is over.
Receptionist
Welcome to the Battle Pyramid! Seven floors in the dark, and the stairs up somewhere on each.
You've climbed {number} floors in a row. The Pyramid King has heard of you!
Would you like to take on the Battle Pyramid?
Enter
The rules
No
You need three Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Please choose the three Pokémon you'll enter.
Thank you! The first floor has been laid out. Watch your step in the dark!
I'm sorry. The three entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the three entered may hold the same item.
Please come again. The Pyramid changes every time, but it's always dark.
Your three go in at Level 50, or at their own level if it's lower. Nothing heals them but what you find.
Each floor is dark. Every battle you win lets you see a little farther. Flash is no help in here.
Find the stairs on seven floors to win the round. If all three of yours faint, the round is over.
Receptionist
Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! Leaders and Champions battle here, and every Pokémon fights at Level 50.
Titles you've won here so far: {number}. The crowd knows your name!
Would you like to enter a tournament?
Enter
The rules
No
You need three Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Which event would you like to enter?
Please choose the three Pokémon you'll enter.
Thank you! The bracket has been drawn. This way to the hall, please!
I'm sorry. The three entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the three entered may hold the same item.
Please come again. The Leaders are always ready for another tournament.
Every Pokémon battles at Level 50 here, raised or lowered to it. Nothing that happens here changes yours.
Eight Trainers enter, and you meet one in each round: three of your Pokémon against three of theirs.
Win three matches and the title is yours. Lose one, and the tournament is over for you.
